Y.QUOTATION_SEQ, Y.REVISION, Y.KEP_USER_NAME, Y.AGENT_NAME, Y.REG_ITEM_NO, Y.CONTRACT_NO, Y.CONTRACT_SEQ, Y.BYCA_COMORG_CODE, Y.BUYER_NAME, Y.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, Y.BTOA_USER_ID, Y.BTOA_REMARK, Y.BTOA_END_TIME, Y.AGENT_REVISION, Y.STOA_LIST_PRICE, Y.ORIGIN_CODE, Y.LEAD_TIME, Y.CMS_CATEG_ID, Y.CMS_CATLG_ID, Y.PROCESS_TYPE, Y.IMPORT_FLAG, Y.WAREHOUSE_CODE, Y.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, Y.ITEM_GROUP , MAX(A.BTOA_USER_NAME) AS BTOA_USER_NAME, MAX(A.KEP_USER_ID) AS KEP_USER_ID, CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='CM' AND MAX(C.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG)='G' THEN '가합의대상' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='GS' THEN BUYER_TARGET_PRICE, MAX(A.ADMIN_TARGET_PRICE) AS ADMIN_TARGET_PRICE, MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE) AS ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, MAX((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND TYPE='C001' AND CODE=A.BTOA_USER_DEPT)) AS BTOA_USER_DEPT, MAX(A.ATOB_REMARK) AS ATOB_REMARK, MAX(A.BTOA_REMARK) AS BTOA_REMARK, MAX(A.IMAGE_KEY) AS IMAGE_KEY, A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION, QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ=A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION=A.REVISION AND BID_SUCCESS_FLAG='Y'),0, (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMBYIT BYIT, ICOMCQDT CQDT, ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE BYIT.BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS <> 'D') AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CQDT.BUYER=BYIT.BUYER AND CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO=BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND CMPY.COM_CODE=CQDT.AGENT AND BYIT.STATUS <> 'D' AND CQDT.STATUS <> 'D'), (SELECT CM.COM_NAME_LOC FROM KEPQTDT QT, ICOMCMPY CM WHERE QT.BUYER=A.BUYER AND QT.QUOTATION_NO=A.QUOTATION_NO AND MAX(A.CONTRACT_NO) AS CONTRACT_NO, MAX(A.CONTRACT_SEQ) AS CONTRACT_SEQ, MAX((SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS BYCA_COMORG_CODE, MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS BUYER_NAME, MAX(C.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG) AS PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, MAX(A.BTOA_USER_ID) AS BTOA_USER_ID, MAX(A.BTOA_END_TIME) AS BTOA_END_TIME, MAX(B.AGENT_REVISION) AS AGENT_REVISION, MAX(B.STOA_LIST_PRICE) AS STOA_LIST_PRICE, MAX(A.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_CODE, MAX(B.LEAD_TIME) AS LEAD_TIME, MAX(NVL(TRIM(A.CMS_CATEG_ID),'NO_CATEG')) AS CMS_CATEG_ID, MAX(NVL(TRIM(A.CMS_CATLG_ID),'NO_CATLG')) AS CMS_CATLG_ID, MAX(A.PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE, MAX(A.IMPORT_FLAG) AS IMPORT_FLAG, MAX(NVL(A.WAREHOUSE_CODE,'')) AS WAREHOUSE_CODE, MAX(A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) AS BELOW_COMORG_CODE , MAX(A.ITEM_GROUP) AS ITEM_GROUP , MAX(A.ITEM_DETAIL_DESC) AS ITEM_DETAIL_DESC , MAX(NVL(A.MSDS_YN,'N')) AS MSDS_YN , MAX(A.MSDS_STATUS) AS MSDS_STATUS , MAX(A.MSDS_NO) AS MSDS_NO , MAX(DECODE(NVL(A.MSDS_YN,'N')||A.MSDS_STATUS,'YC','MSDS 미승인','YA','MSDS 승인')) AS MSDS_TYPE_TEXT , DECODE(MAX(A.RFQ_IMG_TYPE), 'M', MAX(A.IMGFILE_DIR), 'N',MAX(A.IMGFILE_DIR), MAX(B.IMGFILE_DIR)) AS IMGFILE_DIR , DECODE(MAX(A.RFQ_IMG_TYPE), 'M', MAX(A.IMGFILE_NAME),'N',MAX(A.IMGFILE_NAME), MAX(B.IMGFILE_NAME)) AS IMGFILE_NAME , MAX(A.PRE_GR_FLAG) AS PRE_GR_FLAG , MAX(A.SELL_CLOSE_DATE) AS SELL_CLOSE_DATE , MAX(A.BUY_CLOSE_DATE) AS BUY_CLOSE_DATE , MAX(B.MIN_ORDER_QTY) AS MIN_ORDER_QTY , MAX(B.PUR_UNIT_QTY) AS PUR_UNIT_QTY FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B, ICOMBYIT C WHERE 1=1
AND A.BUYER IN

AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='EXCCMPY' AND COD.CODE = A.BUYER AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' ) AND A.SG_ID IN ( SELECT CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE ='CMDSM' AND COD.TEXT1 = #{st_user_id} AND COD.FLAG ='Y' UNION SELECT CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 COD WHERE COD.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND COD.TYPE ='CMSM' AND COD.TEXT1 = #{st_user_id} AND COD.FLAG ='Y' UNION SELECT CODE1 FROM ICOMCOD3 A, ICOMLUSR B WHERE A.BUYER ='KRKORE0001' AND A.TYPE ='CMDSM' AND A.TEXT1 = B.USER_ID AND B.DEPARTMENT IN (SELECT DECODE(C.USER_TYPE,'ST',C.DEPARTMENT,'SOF',B.DEPARTMENT,'') FROM ICOMLUSR C WHERE C.USER_ID =#{st_user_id}) )
AND A.SO_CA_FLAG='SO' AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.QUOTATION_NO=B.QUOTATION_NO AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND A.REVISION=B.REVISION AND B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG='Y' AND A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE <> 0 AND A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG='Y' AND A.RECV_FLAG IN ('GA', 'CM') AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.REG_ITEM_NO AND C.BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER AND STATUS <> 'D') AND DECODE(C.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'S', NULL ,'G', NULL, A.CONFIRM_USER_ID) IS NULL AND A.STATUS IN ('C','R') AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'O'
AND A.QUOTATION_NO = UPPER(#{st_quotation_no})
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = UPPER(#{st_buyer_item_no})

AND (A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%' OR A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%')
GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION ) X ) Y ) Z
mapper.update: INSERT INTO KEPQTDT ( BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION, AGENT, AGENT_REVISION, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, ATOS_DATE, ATOS_END_DATE, ATOS_END_TIME, ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, DSS_FLAG, DSS_CHOICE ) ( SELECT #{BUYER}, /* 1 : BUYER */ #{QUOTATION_NO}, /* 2 : QUOTATION_NO */ #{QUOTATION_SEQ}, /* 3 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ #{REVISION}, /* 4 : REVISION */ #{AGENT}, /* 5 : AGENT */ #{AGENT_REVISION}, /* 6 : AGENT_REVISION */ 'C', BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_CODE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')AS ATOS_DATE, #{ATOS_END_DATE}, /* 7 : ATOS_END_DATE */ #{ATOS_END_TIME}, /* 8 : ATOS_END_TIME */ ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, #{DSS_FLAG}, /* 9 : DSS_FLAG if(chk_str[1].equals("A") || chk_str[1].equals("B") || chk_str[1].equals("C")|| chk_str[1].equals("S")) : Y , 기타 : N */ #{DSS_CHOICE} /* 10 : DSS_CHOICE */ FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER=#{BUYER} /* 11 : BUYER */ AND QUOTATION_NO=#{QUOTATION_NO} /* 12 : QUOTATION_NO */ AND QUOTATION_SEQ=#{QUOTATION_SEQ} /* 13 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ AND REVISION=#{REVISION} /* 14 : REVISION */ AND RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND STATUS IN ('C','R') )

UPDATE ICOMBYIT A /*updateAgrmntICOMBYIT*/ SET A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG=DECODE(A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG, 'T', 'T', 'N'), /* 1 : PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG : N (단, NO_CODE 일 경우 : G) */ A.BUYER_ITEM_NO=#{REG_ITEM_NO}, A.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), A.CHANGE_USER_ID = #{USR_ID}, A.CHANGE_USER_TEL = (SELECT PHONE_NUMBER FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=#{USR_ID}), A.CHANGE_USER_NAME = (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=#{USR_ID}), A.CHANGE_USER_DEPT = (SELECT DEPARTMENT FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=#{USR_ID}), A.DESCRIPTION_LOC = DECODE(#{PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG},'S',#{DESCRIPTION}, A.DESCRIPTION_LOC), A.SPECIFICATION = DECODE(#{PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG},'S',#{SPECIFICATION}, A.SPECIFICATION), A.UNIT_MEASURE = DECODE(#{PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG},'S',#{UNIT_MEASURE}, A.UNIT_MEASURE), A.DELIVERY_LT = DECODE(#{PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG},'S',#{LEAD_TIME}, A.DELIVERY_LT), A.MAKER_NAME = DECODE(#{PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG},'S',#{MAKER_NAME}, A.MAKER_NAME), A.PURCHASER_ID = #{USR_ID}, A.PURCHASER_NAME = (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=#{USR_ID}), A.CMS_CATEG_ID = #{CMS_CATEG_ID}, A.CMS_CATLG_ID=DECODE(#{PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG},'S',NVL(#{CMS_CATLG_ID},''),A.CMS_CATLG_ID), A.ITEM_GROUP=DECODE(#{PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG},'S',#{ITEM_GROUP},A.ITEM_GROUP), A.STATUS='R' , A.ITEM_DETAIL_DESC = #{ITEM_DETAIL_DESC} , A.IMAGE_KEY = #{IMAGE_KEY} , A.IMGFILE_NAME = DECODE(#{IMGFILE_NAME}, '' , A.IMGFILE_NAME, #{IMGFILE_NAME}) , A.IMGFILE_DIR = DECODE(#{IMGFILE_DIR}, '' , A.IMGFILE_DIR,#{IMGFILE_DIR}) , A.MSDS_YN = #{MSDS_YN} , A.MSDS_NO = DECODE(#{MSDS_NO}, 'MS88888888', '', #{MSDS_NO}) , A.MATERIAL_TYPE = (SELECT DECODE(CMC_HARMFUL_YN, 'Y', 'H', NULL) FROM KEPMSDSHD WHERE MSDS_NO = #{MSDS_NO}) WHERE A.BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=#{BUYER} AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{BUYER_ITEM_NO}

/*insertMpRqUnitPricePreCart*/ INSERT INTO ICOMCART (BUYER , USER_ID , BUYER_ITEM_NO , SEQ , CART_QTY , REG_DATE , USE_FLAG , AGENT , CONTRACT_NO , CONTRACT_SEQ , BYIT_COMORG_CODE , PRE_GR_FLAG ) VALUES ( #{BUYER}, #{BTOA_USER_ID}, #{REG_ITEM_NO}, (SELECT DECODE(MAX(SEQ),NULL,'0', MAX(SEQ))+1 FROM ICOMCART WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND USER_ID = #{BTOA_USER_ID}), NVL(#{ITEM_QTY},1), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), 'C', #{AGENT}, #{CONTRACT_NO}, #{CONTRACT_SEQ}, #{BELOW_COMORG_CODE}, 'Y' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS DUP_CNT /*getItemDupChk*/ FROM ICOMBYIT A WHERE A.BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=#{BUYER} AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{REG_ITEM_NO}
mapper.update: /*insertAgrmntRqdtICOMCQEP*/ INSERT INTO ICOMCQEP ( BUYER, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ, PRICE_SEQ, STATUS, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, BUYER_ITEM_NO, FROM_DATE, TO_DATE, FROM_QTY, TO_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, DETAIL_TERM, DETAIL_TERM_QTY, TAX_PRICE, LIST_PRICE, AGENT, REMARK) ( SELECT NVL(B.BUYER, ' '), NVL(B.CONTRACT_NO, ' '), NVL(B.CONTRACT_SEQ, ' '), NVL((SELECT NVL(MAX(C.PRICE_SEQ)+1,1) FROM ICOMCQEP C WHERE C.BUYER = B.BUYER AND C.CONTRACT_NO = B.CONTRACT_NO AND C.CONTRACT_SEQ= B.CONTRACT_SEQ),1) AS PRICE_SEQ, 'C', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS'), NVL(#{G_USR_ID}, ' '), B.BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(B.FROM_DATE, ' '), NVL(B.TO_DATE, ' '), 1 AS FROM_QTY, 99999999 AS TO_QTY, NVL(B.UNIT_PRICE, 0), NULL AS DETAIL_TERM, NULL AS DETAIL_TERM_QTY, NULL AS TAX_PRICE, NVL(B.LIST_PRICE, 0), B.AGENT, #{G_BUYER}||'@@'||#{G_QUOTATION_NO}||'@@'||#{G_QUOTATION_SEQ}||'@@'||#{G_REVISION} AS REMARK FROM ICOMCQDT B WHERE B.BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=#{G_BUYER}) AND B.CONTRACT_NO = #{G_CONTRACT_NO} AND B.CONTRACT_SEQ = #{G_CONTRACT_SEQ} )

UPDATE ICOMBYIT A /*updateAgrmntICOMBYIT_IF*/ SET A.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG='T' /* 1 : PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG : T */ WHERE A.BUYER=(SELECT BYCA_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=#{BUYER} AND STATUS IN ('C','R')) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{REG_ITEM_NO}
